recon.notes:
Parser config at recon: name BEEFMINCE, urls [https://beefmince.com/events], no urlDiscoveryDepth / maxAdditionalUrls / discoveryAllowedPatterns / discoveryBlockedPatterns / alwaysBear / siteRole / automationEnabled set (all defaults; adaptive crawling). Platform: Astro/Zyrosite (Hostinger) static page embedding the DICE Event List Widget, confirmed by the working partners-endpoint.dice.fm/api/v2 call using the page's own partnerId JKRM6GMD + apiKey; /api/v1 was not tried (brief: 404).
Time semantics: feed date/date_end are true instants (Z). The 8 'event' rows and the Welly linkout carry timezone Europe/London and convert cleanly (22:00 BST/GMT starts; the dice.fm event pages print the same wall-clock). The 4 Sitges linkouts carry timezone Africa/Algiers (x3) and Africa/Tunis (x1), both UTC+1 year-round, so their 00:00Z start is 01:00 in that zone but 02:00 in Europe/Madrid; beefmince.com/sitges ('from 01:00 until 06:00'), the news post ('Doors open 01:00') and the sitgesbearcave JSON-LD (01:00+02:00) all say 01:00, so this file records 01:00 Europe/Madrid and treats the feed instant as one hour off. The Butlin's linkout carries timezone Europe/Rome with 17:00Z-17:00Z three days apart; only the date range is trusted.
Date-in-name trap: the Sitges row names say 'Wednesday 9 Sept' etc. (the party night) while the ISO date is the following calendar day (01:00 on the 10th). startDate here is the calendar date of the 01:00 start, matching the sitgesbearcave JSON-LD.
Run 20260909-072307 (parserResults BEEFMINCE, parserType ai-web, urlClassifications {https://beefmince.com/events: multi-event-page}): totalEvents 21, duplicatesRemoved 9, 12 kept, 0 bear-dropped. The 12 = the 8 DICE 'event' rows (ticketUrl = dice.fm/event/<slug> canonical pages, website https://beefmince.com) + the 4 Sitges nights (from the sitgesbearcave.com pages: title 'BEEFMINCE MEET MARKET' etc., bar The Bear Cave, startDate 2026-09-09T23:00:00.000Z = 01:00 Madrid on the 10th, correct). The 9 duplicates are the same events reached twice (widget row vs promoter page / linkout destination). Missing from the run: the Welly Takeover (2026-09-26 linkout) and the Butlin's Don't Tell Mama linkout (2027-01-29).
The Bear Calendar (data/source-expectations/the-bear-calendar.json) republishes 8 BEEFMINCE rows (belongsToSource BEEFMINCE) — theirs to tag, not this file's. 7 of the 8 map onto feed rows (its 'BEEFMINCE x RVT' 2026-09-19 row is the Brief Encounter event: same link.dice.fm/P0194faadd01); its 8th, SPOOKMINCE 2026-10-31 (link.dice.fm/Gffadd9feb4a), is a DICE 404 and absent from the BEEFMINCE feed on 2026-09-10.
No events are flyer-only: all 13 distinct DICE images (flyers/) are brand art; only the Welly flyer carries a date ('saturday 26 september') and it agrees with the feed.

Second door dice.fm/promoters/beefmince-3oorg lists 8 = exactly the type-event rows; the 6-row delta is the linkout type, which DICE does not ticket and does not list on promoter pages. Third door beefmince.com/sitges lists the same 4 Sitges nights the feed's Sitges linkouts point at (same sitgesbearcave.com URLs). The rendered /events DOM contributed 0 rows (island never hydrated under --dump-dom) and is not a reconciliation door. Every row is a dated single; the RVT residency is published as discrete dated rows with no stated rule ('*Now on Saturdays*' is not a schedule), so no series entry exists. Past listings: the feed serves none (row 0 is today's 01:00 Sitges night); beefmince.com news posts and /manchester + /boatmince link 4 past DICE events (12 Apr Eden, 8 Mar Concorde 2, 23 May Area Manchester, 30 Aug BOATMINCE 2026) — counted as traps, not enumerated.
